desc:
🌍 Ragdoll City is now RAGDOLL WORLDS! Same ragdolls, same physics, now with 5 worlds to wreck.
🦖 5 WORLDS: Starter Island, Baseplate, Construction, City and Prehistoric. Pick one and get launched!
🚗 NEW rides to unlock: supercars, a tank, a monster truck, bikes and a rideable raptor.
💥 Punch, throw, blast and crash ragdolls. Every hit is real physics!
⭐ Levels: earn EXP for everything you do and unlock new gear as you level up.
🎟️ NEW CODE: WORLDS = 15 min double EXP! Also CITY = +500 EXP, BOOM = free Nuke Strike. Open the Menu → Codes.
🧰 Over 70 gears: slaps, bats, swords, launchers, the Railgun and many more.
🎁 Daily gifts, a 7-day streak, quests and badges to chase.
🚙 Drive the dune buggy around Starter Island.
🪂 Jump off the Parachute Tower and open your chute!

Can't wait for a gear? Most can be unlocked early in the SHOP.
Your Level, gear and purchases save for your next visit.
